Name: Compatibility Patches for Starry Blue UI
Author: cookietehcat
Description:
This page is a hub for all the compatibility matches I've made for personal use while playing with Starry Blue UI. Not much else to it..

I'm open to suggestions if there's any mods that you've spotted an incompatibility!

Obviously be sure to check out the original mod!:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13694]Starry Blue UI by sqbr[/url]﻿


[b][u]Currently supported mods:
[/u][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu by spacechase0
[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21620]Crafting Collections Page by Gurm0[/url]﻿

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7907]Quality Smash by barfytheclown
[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting by Khloe Lecair
[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467]Font Settings by Becks723[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2536]Mod Update Menu by CatCattyCat[/url] (Currently using the unofficial 1.6 version)

﻿[u]Install:[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download the compatibility patch you need.
[*]Simply drag and drop the folder over your existing folder for the associated mod. Make sure to say yes to replacing the files.
[*]Launch the game as normal and it should work!
[/list]
